nodes.label: GameState TypedDict
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for LangGraph shared state (schemas/); TypedDict with Annotated operator.add reducers so skills/inventory/relationships/tool_results accumulate across nodes.

nodes.label: GameState character_stats field
nodes.rationale: Optional CharacterStats snapshot carried in state so mechanics/summarizer/story nodes share one canonical stat block.

nodes.label: GameState inventory field
nodes.rationale: Reducing list (operator.add) of InventoryItem so parallel mechanics can append loot deterministically.

nodes.label: GameState grid_data field
nodes.rationale: Dict of GridCell lists holding the 15x15 encounter/world view shared between image/worldgen nodes and story.

nodes.label: GameState rolling memory (context/chat_log)
nodes.rationale: Rolling context string capped at 8000 chars plus 40-turn chat_log keep prompts bounded; story-buffer drains to vector memory every 25 turns to preserve history without state explosion.

nodes.label: GameState decision routing fields
nodes.rationale: Entry classifier writes DecisionReport plus legacy needs_* flags; react_router picks next_node with budget terminators (3 passes, 12 LLM calls, 60s) forcing to story for bounded latency/cost.

nodes.label: GridCell model
nodes.rationale: 15x15 grid cell contract (items/ores/entities/terrain/prerequisites/cell/description); image node validates LLM output into it so downstream nodes get typed cells.

nodes.label: DecisionReport model
nodes.rationale: Cheap deterministic fast-path first, LLM only when ambiguous; confidence below 0.6 routes straight to mechanics to save cost.

nodes.label: ContextSummary model
nodes.rationale: Compressed quests/location/party/events/inventory/time/weather summary keeps story prompts bounded after context_refresh appends fresh tool results.

nodes.label: GameOutput model
nodes.rationale: Final uuid/game_data/story/context_summary/tool_results pushed under output: prefix with game_over flag so client closes the run when dead.

nodes.label: Settings dataclass
nodes.rationale: Zero hardcoded values, all env-driven: redis/models/search/app groups keep config swappable without code changes.

nodes.label: RedisConfig
nodes.rationale: Single Upstash Redis with input:/output:/games: prefixes separates queue, results and long-lived state without multi-DB ops; host/port DBs kept only as unused local fallback.

nodes.label: ModelConfig
nodes.rationale: OpenRouter-only model slate per stage (classifier/image/redescribe/story/context/jev) so slugs swap via env with no code touch.

nodes.label: AppConfig budgets
nodes.rationale: Generous local budgets with hard terminators (router 3 passes, 12 LLM calls, 24000 tokens, 60s deadline, semaphore 16, 90% memory backoff) guarantee bounded per-turn latency and cost.

nodes.label: resolve_attack
nodes.rationale: Pure-code Node-4 mechanics run on immutable snapshots with ordered merge: no shared mutable state, no races, deterministic; d20 vs armor+dodge with advantage, crit doubling dice and full armor pen.

nodes.label: generate_world (6x6 regions)
nodes.rationale: Seeded region-lattice world: neighbor-biased fill plus distance-to-center assignment keeps biomes coherent while staying reproducible from items-db lists.

nodes.label: generate_cell (per-coordinate)
nodes.rationale: Every world coordinate maps to exactly one deterministic cell per seed; stored cells are immutable afterwards so only freshly generated frontier reflects a risen difficulty scalar.

nodes.label: ensure_world (migrate/init)
nodes.rationale: Idempotent world bootstrap: migrates legacy 6x6 saves in place, otherwise builds a fresh deterministic grid with origin/player_pos so old saves never break.

nodes.label: maybe_expand_world / get_world_cell
nodes.rationale: Border-margin expansion materializes deterministic rows/columns on approach (capped at 64 to avoid state explosion); out-of-bounds lookahead regenerates without storing.

nodes.label: kill_xp formula
nodes.rationale: XP = xp_base * level * rarity * tier * type multipliers (rounded half-up, min 1); non-killing attack turns grant a participation tick of kill//4 so chip damage still progresses.

nodes.label: roll_loot / resolve_loot_entry
nodes.rationale: Loot parsed from item-db enemy Loot strings and rolled with rarity luck plus tier bonus rolls; missing DB rows fall back to rarity-pool picks or plain gold instead of failing.

nodes.label: adaptive difficulty scalar
nodes.rationale: RE4-style 1.0x-4.0x scalar deliberately slow (heat weighted by victim rarity, ~150 common kills plus two months to cap) and one-directional: the world gets meaner, never kinder; drives both pack density and spawn stats.

nodes.label: to_int / clamp_int
nodes.rationale: One home for defensive ints so Redis round-tripped dicts and stat clamps (mortal 3-30 scale) stay short and total at call sites.

nodes.label: as_dict / model_list
nodes.rationale: Pydantic-or-dict coercions let nodes accept turn-1 models and turn-2+ persisted dicts identically after Redis serialization.

nodes.label: ItemsDB store
nodes.rationale: In-memory zero-dependency DB loaded from items-db JSON so worldgen/loot never pay an API call; query cache plus name/type/rarity indexes keep lookups cheap.

nodes.label: ItemsDB search/extract/filter
nodes.rationale: Exact then substring then bigram-cosine plus edit-distance rerank tolerates player typos without external search.

nodes.label: OpenRouterDirectClient
nodes.rationale: Direct HTTP for all LLM calls: faster and more controllable than LangChain wrappers, single client with uniform response_format; fails loudly on empty/overload envelopes so node fallbacks trigger.

nodes.label: chat_json strict-JSON helper
nodes.rationale: One strict-JSON call path handling list envelopes, code fences, trailing prose and timeouts so every node gets parseable JSON.

nodes.label: v2 LangGraph pipeline
nodes.rationale: Classifier to re-entrant ReAct router over 3 conditional service nodes to parallel mechanics to context_refresh to summarizer to story to pusher: fixed edges plus conditional router loop-backs give multi-need turns without branching the graph per request.

nodes.label: Parallel pure mechanics
nodes.rationale: Snapshot fan-out plus ordered merge means no shared mutable state, no races, deterministic results; no Redis writes inside sub-nodes and idempotency via turn_id.

nodes.label: Budget-first ReAct router
nodes.rationale: Passes, LLM-call and deadline terminators force to story so per-turn latency and cost stay bounded even when flags keep firing.

nodes.label: OpenRouter-only model layer
nodes.rationale: Single API pattern via shared chat_json helper: no LangChain wrappers, no Gemini SDK, no Google key; per-stage free-tier models tunable by env.

nodes.label: v2 pipeline stage table
nodes.rationale: One glanceable contract of stage, role, model and type so contributors place logic in the right node instead of growing the orchestrator.

nodes.label: Rolling memory and TTL
nodes.rationale: Bounded context plus timed expiry trades perfect recall for predictable cost: recent turns stay verbatim, older history compacts via summarizer and vector drain.

nodes.label: Concurrency and edge cases
nodes.rationale: Semaphore cap plus memory backpressure plus force-to-story terminators keep 100+ concurrent storms and router overruns from cascading.
